description.zh:
证书类型。
- upload（上传证书）
- cas（云盾证书）
- free（个人测试证书（免费版））
description.en:
The certificate type.

- upload: Upload certificate

- cas: Alibaba Cloud Security certificate

- free: Personal test certificate (Free Edition)

description.zh:
指定证书所属加速域名。

> 域名需要属于HTTPS加速类型。
description.en:
The accelerated domain name to which the certificate belongs.

> The domain must use HTTPS acceleration.

description.zh: 设置为1时，忽略证书名称重复的校验，覆盖原有同名证书信息。
description.en: Set to 1 to skip the certificate name duplication check and overwrite an existing certificate with the same name.

description.zh: 私钥内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入私钥内容。
description.en: The private key content. Omit this parameter if you disable the certificate. Provide the private key content if you configure a certificate.

description.zh:
HTTPS证书是否启用。取值：

- **on**：启用。
- **off**（默认值）：不启用。
description.en:
Whether to enable the HTTPS certificate. Valid values:

- **on**: Enable.

- **off** (default): Disable.

description.zh: 安全证书内容，不启用证书则无需输入，配置证书请输入证书内容。
description.en: The public certificate content. Omit this parameter if you disable the certificate. Provide the certificate content if you configure a certificate.
